title: Super Tenere 1200 (Track Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Yamaha Super Tenere 1200 (Track Edition) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1200cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
